name: snow-docs
title_zh: 装完 Snow CLI 后，用它自己管自己
tagline_zh: Profile、MCP、Skills、Hooks、子代理、敏感命令——不再靠模型瞎猜，官方文档按需翻，问到哪查到哪。
tagline_en: Stop guessing about Profile, MCP, Skills, Hooks, sub-agents, sensitive commands—official docs on tap, fetched.
desc_en: Use when the user asks to install, configure, troubleshoot, or understand Snow CLI itself — Profile/API setup, MCP servers, Skills, Hooks, sub-agents, sensitive commands, proxy/browser, third-party relay, LSP/ACE, Team mode, SSE, privacy, plugins, or docs paths. Loads official bundled usage docs via progressive disclosure (list/search/get) instead of guessing from model memory.
why_zh: 渐进式披露（list/search/get）按需加载官方文档，不把整本手册塞进上下文。
why_en: Progressive disclosure (list/search/get) pulls official docs on demand—no context bloat, answers grounded in source, not model.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Snow CLI 自身的使用与排障，不碰业务代码或第三方工具配置；离线或文档未收录的边角场景。
limit_en: Only covers Snow CLI itself—not business code or third-party tools. Offline or undocumented edge cases get 'check the official repo' as the answer.
